title: RBAC permission denied for service account
symptoms: Application logs: User system:serviceaccount:ns:sa cannot get/list/create resource
CI/CD pipeline fails on kubectl apply
root_cause: Missing RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding; RBAC not managed in GitOps; service account renamed without updating bindings; OIDC group mapping stale
workaround: Apply emergency RoleBinding from runbook template (time-limited, requires approval); verify with kubectl auth can-i
permanent_fix: Manage all RBAC in GitOps repo with PR review; automate SA provisioning via Helm subchart; quarterly RBAC audit; map OIDC groups to ClusterRoles

auto_healing.mechanism: ArgoCD auto-sync restores RBAC from Git; no auto-grant of new permissions

notes: Track emergency RBAC grants with 24h expiry and audit log
